findings.problem: RP-M8 added Bazaar line 4406 as the link's primary source, the §54 heading 'and there were not two Sons but one by an union.' That line is about doctrine. It shows the text exists, but not that the Church of the East kept it. The custody still rests on the editors, which is honest and enough for Widely Accepted, so this is not substantial.
findings.fix: Optional: replace it with a line of the Syriac text or the colophon, if the file holds one. Otherwise label the primary 'the Syriac-derived text itself (chapter heading)' so it is not read as evidence of custody.
